old_target: TGFB1 -> TGFBR/SMAD -> ITGB1/alpha-beta1 expression and matrix-adhesion remodeling
new_target: TGF-beta1 -> integrin-beta1/alpha-beta1 surface expression -> matrix-adhesion remodeling
decision_basis: Primary human WI-38 fibroblast work shows that TGF-beta1 increases beta1 and alpha-subunit expression, assembly into alpha-beta1 complexes, and cell-surface exposure; a separate primary A549 adhesion study supports latent-TGF-beta-LAP interaction with alphaVbeta1. This supports a bounded TGF-beta1-integrin-beta1 functional/adhesion association, not direct TGFB1-ITGB1 binding or a terminal TF target.
